title: File Transfer & Temporary Chat
description: Connect your devices or another person to share files, send text and talk privately.
description_subtitle: No chat app to install. Optional disappearing texts and encrypted file sharing; both browsers must stay online.

guide.title: Private browser chat and file sharing without an app
guide.summary: FreeSaveVideo is a video download and browser tools website. Its file-transfer page also supports temporary one-to-one text conversations with someone you know. Create a random session and share its link or code to connect, with optional disappearing messages for new texts. It suits short exchanges when you do not want to add a social contact, install another messenger or keep the conversation in your everyday chat history.

scenarios.devices: Between your devices: send phone photos, computer files, links and notes to another device.
scenarios.sharing: With a friend or colleague: exchange files and discuss them without adding another social contact.
scenarios.conversation: For a private conversation: discuss personal or family matters in a separate browser session without adding the exchange to your everyday chat list.
scenarios.discreet: A discreet tool-site entry: the website provides video downloads and file transfer, with chat as one feature, so there is no separate chat app to install on your phone.

guide.steps_title: How to start a temporary conversation

steps.create: Create a random session to chat with another person without signing in. Personal sessions are for devices using the same account.
steps.invite: Privately share the session link or code, or scan its QR code on the second device. Do not publish session credentials.
steps.chat: Once connected, choose Chat & Text. For disappearing texts, enable the option above the composer before sending; the 30-second countdown begins when the recipient clicks to reveal the message. You can also switch to File Transfer. Keep both pages open and online.
steps.finish: Use End This Session or Leave This Session when finished. Closing a page does not mean all device and browser traces have been erased.

guide.faq_title: Temporary chat and message history FAQ

wechat.question: Can I talk privately without adding messages to WeChat or LINE history?
wechat.answer: Yes. Two people who know each other can use a separate browser session for text and files; its content is not automatically synced to WeChat or LINE. Invitations sent through those apps may remain in their history. This tool does not delete other apps' records or guarantee that it will prevent relationship conflicts.

install.question: Do both people need an app, account or friend request?
install.answer: Random sessions require no app installation, account or friend request. Use WebRTC-capable browsers and connect with a link, code or QR code. Both people must be online, and network restrictions can prevent connection. Personal sessions require the same signed-in account on both devices.

history.question: Where is chat history saved? Is it destroyed immediately after use?
history.answer: Optional disappearing texts are supported. New texts sent with this option stay in page memory only. Clicking to reveal starts a countdown; with a working connection, both conversations remove the message after about 30 seconds. Disappearing texts are also cleared when a closed connection or page departure is detected. Background browser suspension may delay execution; expiry is checked on return. Ordinary texts stay in tab session storage and may survive refresh. Files are excluded, and device-level unrecoverable deletion is not guaranteed.

disguise.question: Is there a website that does not look like a messenger but offers private, disappearing chat?
disguise.answer: FreeSaveVideo is a video download and tools website. Its file-transfer page also offers one-to-one private chat with optional disappearing texts, providing a discreet tool-site entry without a separate chat app. Disappearing messages clear conversation content, not browser visit history. Open chat pages, screenshots and downloaded files may still be visible.

privacy.question: Does encryption stop the recipient from saving or screenshotting messages?
privacy.answer: No. WebRTC encrypts the transfer, while a server coordinates session connections. This does not imply complete anonymity or a service with no logs. Recipients can still copy text, take screenshots or photos, and save files. Share only with people you trust.

files.question: Can I send files during a chat or receive messages offline?
files.answer: Once connected, switch between files and text without uploading files to a cloud drive first. Both browsers need an online connection; offline message delivery is not provided. Keep the pages open and avoid changing networks during transfers.
